value.note: PMs orchestrate and compose; they only code solo when no fan-out is needed. Prime is product owner and has final say.
Coders work one unit each per the impl-guide; isolation shape (own worktree vs pm's branch) is set per-plan in the impl-guide.
Cross-model review after composition (or after solo-pm coding). Verified against `pij models` 2026-08-28.
